items.rationale: Overvoltage from lightning is covered under 2.3.3 within the EUR 5,000 appliance sub-limit; replacement is limited to a like-for-like standard-grade unit (7.1.9). Surge protection is not established as missing, so no halving; price calibrated to reference Case 9 (t below 336).
Carriage and delivery of replacement property are not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b) and are excluded from 5.2.2.
Installing, connecting and setting up replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(c).

Surge-damaged TV is covered under 2.3.3 within the sub-limit, at the cost of an equivalent replacement (7.1.9), with no reduction because missing surge protection is not established. Calibrated to reference Case 9 (t between 517 and 616).

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: This charge bundles a liability risk and a service arrangement without separate pricing, so it falls outside cover entirely under 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
A charge for placing an order under a service arrangement is expressly excluded by 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Under 7.1.8(d) an attendance charge is payable only alongside indemnifiable work on the same invoice; nothing else on this invoice is indemnifiable.
